findings.issue: `atFinitePlace_equivalent_of_prod_equivalent_prod_of_equivalent` (107-116) and `atRealPlace_equivalent_of_prod_equivalent_prod_of_equivalent` (119-129) are line-for-line clones: same three steps (`*Prod` isometry, `Equivalent.at*Place`, `equivalent_of_equivalent_prod`) with `atFinitePlace`/`atRealPlace` swapped. summary: The new local lemmas (`localHasse_eq_neg_of_ne`, `add_eq_add_iff_ne`) are genuinely new and reuse the local classification well, but the new global file re-derives the existing public `QuadraticForm.discr_atFinitePlace` inside its proof (which is the sole reason `formClass_atFinitePlace` is made public), and proves the same base-change cancellation fact twice in two near-identical theorems.
